capabilities: insert a due date for the end of this week at the cursor
insert a due date for the end of next week at the cursor
insert a due date for the end of this month, optionally the last weekday
insert a due date 100 years in the future for tasks never to be done
add configurable hashtags alongside each inserted due date
extras: Due dates use the [due:: YY-MM-DD] inline-field format, which pairs with Dataview-style queries, though the README does not name any plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in shortcuts for inserting relative due dates such as end of this week or end of next month, so they must be typed and calculated by hand.
summary: Command-based date inserter that adds four commands to insert due dates like [due:: YY-MM-DD] at the cursor, with optional hashtags.
